## Scene to Generate

Using the art style, location, and character appearances from the labeled reference images above, generate this scene:

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Main room of Grandma's cottage. Grandma (small, hunched, white hair tied back, deeply lined kind face, simple long dress and apron) stands by a low wooden table holding out with both hands a neatly folded bundle of bright green cloth topped with a pointed green cap; a pair of small brown boots sits on the table beside her. THE HERO'S TUNIC, clearly the gift, centered in the composition. Toon Link (blue shirt, orange shorts, no cap) stands before her staring at the green cloth with huge amazed eyes. Aryll peeks from behind Link, both hands pressed to her mouth in delight. Warm amber interior light. Medium shot, the folded green tunic visually central. Square 1:1, no text in image.

## Scene to Generate

Using the art style, location, and character appearances from the labeled reference images above, generate this scene:

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. THE TRANSFORMATION. Toon Link now stands in the center of the cottage wearing the full iconic green hero's outfit for the first time: bright green tunic, bright green long pointed cap, brown leather belt with gold buckle, brown boots. His arms are slightly spread, looking down at himself, a wide amazed grin spreading across his face. A warm golden shaft of light falls on him — he looks genuinely transformed. Aryll (pink dress, pigtails) jumps in the air beside him in pure delight, pigtails flying. Grandma watches from the side, one hand pressed over her heart, eyes soft. Medium shot, Link centered and glowing. Square 1:1, no text in image.

## Scene to Generate

Using the art style, location, and character appearances from the labeled reference images above, generate this scene:

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Split focus composition. Dominating the frame: over the distant ocean, an ENORMOUS dark bird — the Helmaroc King (huge wingspan, black feathers with red accents, fearsome beaked mask-face with yellow eyes, sharp talons) — wings spread wide. Clutched in its huge talons: a small struggling girl, Tetra (blue vest, white shirt, short blonde ponytail). In the foreground lower corner: Toon Link's shocked face (green cap, huge eyes blown wide), the red telescope still at one eye, mouth open in alarm. Dark menacing silhouette against bright blue sky. The peace has just cracked. Square 1:1, no text in image.

## Scene to Generate

Using the art style, location, and character appearances from the labeled reference images above, generate this scene:

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. The grassy cliff-top near the lookout tower. An enormous dark bird-shaped shadow sweeps across the bright green grass. Toon Link (green hero's tunic, green cap, small sword in hand) and Tetra (blue vest, white shirt, ponytail) are both looking up, faces caught in the shadow, expressions darkening with dread. In the middle distance, flying low over the cottages of the village, the huge dark Helmaroc King (black feathers, masked beak face, huge wingspan) banks and circles, hunting. On a separate cliff across from them, small and alone, stands Aryll (tiny pink dress, sunhat, pigtails) shading her eyes with one hand, looking up at the bird — the bird is turning toward her. Wide shot, dread gathering. Square 1:1, no text in image.

## Scene to Generate

Using the art style, location, and character appearances from the labeled reference images above, generate this scene:

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. THE EMOTIONAL LOW POINT. The huge Helmaroc King (black feathers with red accents, masked beaked face, massive wingspan) has swooped in and clutched tiny Aryll (pink dress, pigtails) in its huge talons. She is being lifted into the sky, her pink sunhat flying loose, her small arms reaching back toward the island, her mouth wide open in a scream. Across the cliff-top, Toon Link (green hero's tunic, green cap) has dropped his small sword on the grass and is RUNNING toward her with both arms outstretched, face transformed with pure horror, mouth open in a shout. Tetra (blue vest, ponytail) stands behind him, frozen, face shocked. Everything is terror, motion, and too-late. Square 1:1, no text in image.

## Scene to Generate

Using the art style, location, and character appearances from the labeled reference images above, generate this scene:

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. The very edge of the cliff. Toon Link (green hero's tunic, green cap, brown boots) has skidded to a stop at the brink, one hand still reaching upward toward the sky, the other arm falling slack — but the bird is already far away, shrunk to a small dark shape carrying an even smaller pink speck out over the vast empty ocean. Link's face is devastated: mouth open, huge eyes wide and wet, arm dropping. Wind tugs his cap. The ocean stretches enormous and empty between him and his sister. Tetra stands a few paces behind him, watching silently, face unreadable. The smallness of one boy against a vast unreachable horizon. Wide emotional shot. Square 1:1, no text in image.

Tetra (blue vest over white shirt, brown trousers, red bandana, short blonde ponytail) is half-turned, one foot raised to step toward her pirate ship anchored just offshore. Toon Link (green hero's tunic, green cap, brown boots, small sword on his back) has caught her sleeve with one hand — his other hand points out over the water in the direction the bird flew. His face: tear-streaked cheeks but jaw set hard, huge eyes fierce with resolve — demanding, not begging. Tetra turns her head to look at him, sharp blue eyes narrowing, considering. Afternoon sun, pirate ship in background. Close-medium shot, emotional. Square 1:1, no text in image.

Using the art style, location, and character appearances from the labeled reference images above, generate this scene:

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. The beach and dock. Toon Link (green hero's tunic, green cap, brown boots, small sword in hand, tunic a little dirty) stands at the foot of the gangplank below, looking up at her. In the background on the beach edge, small but visible: Grandma (hunched, white hair, long dress and apron), one hand pressed to her mouth, watching her grandson prepare to sail away. ## Scene to Generate

Using the art style, location, and character appearances from the labeled reference images above, generate this scene:

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. FINAL IMAGE. The pirate ship under full sail cuts across deep blue open ocean, white sails full of wind, skull-and-crossbones flag streaming. Outset Island is already receding in the distance — small and green behind them, a shrinking silhouette. Toon Link (green hero's tunic, green cap, brown boots) stands at the back of the ship, both hands resting on the wooden rail, looking back at the shrinking island. On the distant tiny beach: Grandma, still standing alone where they left her, one hand raised in a small wave. Link's face: not crying anymore — set, older somehow. Sad but going. Wind in his green cap. Long slanting afternoon light. Wide bittersweet shot — one boy, a receding home, the beginning of a journey. Square 1:1, no text in image.
